schema: CREATE TABLE "Quotes" ("item_id" INTEGER, "vendor" TEXT, "amount" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "vendor"), CHECK ("amount" > 0));
correct_query: SELECT item_id, SUM(CASE WHEN vendor = 'alpha' THEN amount ELSE NULL END) AS alpha_amt, SUM(CASE WHEN vendor = 'beta' THEN amount ELSE NULL END) AS beta_amt FROM quotes GROUP BY item_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Rewriting SUM(CASE WHEN cond THEN col ELSE NULL END) as CASE WHEN SUM(cond) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM((cond) * col) END returns 0 instead of NULL when a group has a matching row with col IS NULL and a non-matching row with non-NULL col (0 * col = 0).
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT ITEM_ID, CASE WHEN SUM(VENDOR = 'alpha') = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM((VENDOR = 'alpha') * AMOUNT) END AS ALPHA_AMT, CASE WHEN SUM(VENDOR = 'beta') = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM((VENDOR = 'beta') * AMOUNT) END AS BETA_AMT FROM QUOTES GROUP BY ITEM_ID
